title: Record step probe machine
statement: For any symbol alphabet, a four-work-tape machine has the start state, with states given by the record step probe states. In the start state, if the input head scans a symbol, it stays in place and moves to the done state with value false; if the input is blank, it moves right and enters the peek state. In the peek state it moves left and enters the done state with value true exactly when the input is blank, while each done state stays in place and remains unchanged.
